title: clinopodium carolinianum
intro: Clinopodium carolinianum, commonly known as Carolina clammy ground cherry, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Clinopodium carolinianum include its ability to soothe digestive issues, calm the nervous system, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
